mathematical_meanings: Left image: A names the matrix printed after the equals sign (the label before the three-row decimal matrix). Right image: A names the matrix printed after the equals sign (the label before the leftmost of three matrices).
Rationales: In both images, A names the matrix printed after the equals sign. The relevant locations are the label before the three-row decimal matrix on the left and the label before the leftmost of three matrices on the right.
